title: Exact-single supported Cartier comparison square
statement: In the finite-coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions], let i:D→T be a closed effective Cartier divisor over k with invertible kernel ideal. Use agreementCartierEtale and agreementCartierMap of [def-pur-cartier-agreement-maps]. The derived image of the etale Cartier Ext arrow, followed by the canonical shift and shifted exact-single comparisons, equals closedSectionEpsilon followed by agreementCartierMap. Here closedSectionEpsilon is the degree-zero exact-single comparison followed by the uniquely normalized supported-constant comparison of [lem-pur-supported-cup-functoriality], as explicitly defined in [lem-pur-comparison-image-closed-section-normalization]. The equation is the supported square alone; it says nothing about compact support, local divisor formulas, or a normalized compact source.

proof.text: Expand agreementCartierMap and functorialCupCompare. The single image of the supported-source comparison cancels the inverse source factor. The exact-single comparison and inverse cancel next. Target twist transport is identity by the defining comparison-image presentation of the finite Tate twist. Associativity gives the displayed equation. No Cartier arrow is cancelled or assumed invertible.

theorem cartierSupported_comparison_square (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {D T : Scheme.{u}} (a : T ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    (i : D ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible) :
    (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) T).mapDerivedCategory.map
        (P.cartierComparisonEtaleMap a i hI).hom ≫ (P.cartierComparisonTwist T).hom =
      (closedSectionEpsilon P i).hom ≫ (P.cartierComparisonProMap a i hI).hom
